label: baryon_table_corrections
source: PDG 2025 summary tables, N and Delta baryons (S. Navas et al. (Particle Data Group), Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001 (2024) and 2025 update; rpp2025-tab-baryons-N.pdf and rpp2025-tab-baryons-Delta.pdf, created 2025-05-30); .collab/sources/pdg/rpp2025-tab-baryons-N.txt
reason: The Gemini review of 2026-10-21 (.collab/, gap B3) found two committed baryon tables the PDG updates of R84 and R100 left at the legacy Round 2 transcription. The Delta(1600) and Delta(1700) carry N pi, Delta pi and N rho only (the Delta(1600) N rho at 27%, a mode the PDG 2025 table does not list; its N(1440) pi of 17-27% absent; the Delta(1700) without N(1520) pi, N(1535) pi and Delta eta). The Lambda(1520) Lambda pi pi isospin, a transcription error, is a revision of the committed catalog (helpers/benchmarking/catalog_dipion_isospin_revision.py).
rule: the decay tables only, at the committed masses and widths (the N* tables of R84 and R100 keep theirs; the widths are KernelConfig.baryon_pdg_widths, the masses an open item of the catalog's edition); each Delta mode at its PDG range (the N pi pi total replaced by its listed Delta pi and N rho parts), the fractions at one common position inside the ranges (the N* range rule); the partial wave the PDG names, else the lowest the J^P allow; the charge splits by isospin Clebsch-Gordan coefficients
widths_rule: KernelConfig.baryon_pdg_widths: the committed N* and Delta records whose Breit-Wigner widths differ from the PDG 2025 estimates (the values the PDG 2025 N and Delta records of KernelConfig.pdg_nucleon_resonances carry) at those estimates, the masses kept (the catalog's validation pins them to the vendored table); each support's upper edge at five widths above the pole, the committed records' rule
